value.rationale: Nonnegativity is a natural and explicitly motivated institutional restriction on cooperative entry payments. The exact first 7-player failure of nonnegativity for a unique canonical closest flow, plus the constrained optimum and explicit monetary adjustment penalty, distinguishes implementability from optimal limited-liability design and provides a non-arbitrary benchmark for a game with standard pairwise synergies.
